figure_caption: Estimation setting and information boundary. Source response matrices determine a shared score-directed item path and a source-selected decoder using lineage-disjoint source validation. The nested query prefixes are fixed before target answers arrive and shared across targets. Only queried target responses and source-fitted state enter prediction of the arithmetic mean over all retained benchmark items. Full target responses and their true full-benchmark mean remain evaluation-only references, with no information flow into fitting or prediction. The supplied implementation permits an optional nonlinear decoder blend, but the optional branch is not independently attested per case.

panels.title: Score-targeted prediction and information boundary
panels.short_caption: Source-only fitting freezes a common nested item path and decoder; queried target answers produce an estimate of full retained-item accuracy, while target truth remains outside prediction. The optional nonlinear blend is not independently attested per case.
panels.drawio_prompt: Single idea: a source-fitted shared item path and source-selected frozen decoder estimate a target's full retained-item mean from only queried answers, with full target truth excluded from all fitting and prediction. Draw one connected overview on a wide 21:9 canvas, not multiple mini-panels. The left roughly four-fifths contain the predictor, with source fitting above target inference; a narrow truth area occupies the right, behind a strong vertical information-boundary rule. REGIONS: source_fit is a bounded grouping labelled 'Source-only fitting', containing source_data, statistics, selector, and validation; this is source fitting, not target training. frozen_package is a grouping labelled 'Frozen package', encompassing shared_path above and decoder below; both are source-fitted artifacts frozen at inference. inference is an open lower lane labelled 'Target inference', containing target_model, query, observations, decoder, and estimate; avoid overlapping opaque containers where this lane meets frozen_package. truth_region is the rightmost grouping labelled 'Evaluation-only truth', containing truth_responses, full_mean, true_score; none is an inference input. boundary is the strong vertical separating rule labelled 'Target-truth boundary', not a flow edge. NODES, with stable IDs and semantic encodings: source_data is a sharp observed-data rectangle labelled 'Source responses' and '$$X$$', with a small schematic binary row-column matrix inset; it is not trainable. statistics is a rounded source-fitted computation labelled 'Lineage-weighted statistics' and '$$C, c$$', denoting item covariance and covariance with source full scores. selector is a rounded source-trained process labelled 'Score-directed selection', with the short subordinate labels 'Residual score covariance', 'Conditional variance', and 'One item per group'; these explain the regularized greedy gain and content-group constraint without an equation or three extra boxes. validation is a rounded source-only fitting process labelled 'Lineage-disjoint validation', selecting settings without target truth. shared_path is a sharp frozen-artifact card labelled 'Shared nested path'; draw an ordered item strip with three nested prefix brackets or outlines labelled '$$Q_5$$', '$$Q_{10}$$', '$$Q_{25}$$'. Prefixes extend the same path, not unrelated sets; avoid 25 microscopic numbered cells. Include 'All targets' as a short qualifier. target_model is a rounded external execution node labelled 'Target model'; it is queried, not trained by this method. query is a rounded forward process labelled 'Query k items', consuming fixed indices and target-model access. observations is a sharp observed-data rectangle labelled 'Queried responses' and '$$y_{Q_k}$$', optionally with a small schematic binary strip. decoder is a rounded source-fitted process frozen at inference, labelled 'Source-selected decoder', with 'Ridge + offset' as the primary descriptor and 'Optional nonlinear blend' subordinate inside the same box. A small adjacent 'Branch not attested' qualifier records the evidentiary limit; do not depict a proven active nonlinear branch or separate nonlinear output. estimate is a sharp result rectangle labelled 'Estimated full accuracy', '$$\hat{s}$$', and 'All N retained items'; it is the principal output and is not queried-subset accuracy. truth_responses is a sharp withheld-data rectangle labelled 'Full target responses' and '$$y$$'; it contains both queried and unqueried responses. full_mean is a rounded reference-only deterministic operation labelled 'Retained-item mean'; it is not learned. true_score is a sharp reference-data rectangle labelled 'Full accuracy', '$$s(y)$$', and 'All N retained items'; it defines the estimation target but is never supplied to prediction. EDGES, exhaustive: source_data -> statistics, solid forward data flow, unlabelled; statistics -> selector, solid forward data flow, unlabelled; source_data -> validation, solid source-data flow, unlabelled, routed beneath statistics within the source lane; validation -> selector, dashed auxiliary settings flow, labelled 'Settings'; validation -> decoder, dashed auxiliary settings flow, unlabelled; statistics -> decoder, solid source-fitted parameter flow, labelled 'Source fit'; selector -> shared_path, solid artifact flow, unlabelled; shared_path -> query, solid fixed-index flow, labelled '$$Q_k$$'; target_model -> query, solid forward model access/data flow, unlabelled; query -> observations, solid forward data flow, unlabelled; observations -> decoder, solid forward data flow, unlabelled; decoder -> estimate, solid forward prediction flow, unlabelled; truth_responses -> full_mean, solid reference-only flow entirely within truth_region, unlabelled; full_mean -> true_score, solid reference-only flow entirely within truth_region, unlabelled. No other edges. In particular, no arrows cross the target-truth boundary, no full-target-score input enters source fitting or decoding, and no target answers feed back to selector or shared_path. No gradients. Matching estimate and true_score via their shared all-retained-items descriptor communicates the estimation target without a comparison metric, results plot, or evaluation loop. SPATIAL ARRANGEMENT: across the upper predictor lane place source_data, statistics, selector, shared_path from left to right, with validation beneath source_data/statistics but above the inference lane. Across the lower lane place target_model and query at left, observations center-left, decoder center-right directly below shared_path, and estimate at the predictor's right edge immediately before the boundary. Route shared_path -> query through a clear inter-lane elbow channel, distinct from statistics -> decoder and validation -> decoder. Prevent label collisions; if edges cross, use bridges and distinct edge colors assigned by the style phase. Stack truth_responses, full_mean, true_score vertically at right, aligning true_score roughly with estimate. A single optional 'Frozen' tag may supplement frozen_package if needed. IMPORTANCE RANKING: first the full-benchmark-mean estimate and conspicuous truth exclusion; second the shared nested nonadaptive path and source-selected frozen decoder; third source-only validation and covariance-directed selection; fourth optional decoder detail.
